}}'''Marasale Jureen''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]] who was raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] in the year {{Ne|705}} and served in that capacity until {{Ne|732}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Marasale Jureen}}

==History==
Marasale's name could indicate a [[Domani]] origin (see [[Duhara Basaheen]], [[Saroiya Farseen]], [[Sanaiye Asaheen]], and [[Hafeen Bakuvun]]).

She was the Amyrlin Seat at the time of [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] and [[Romanda Cassin]]'s births.

Marasale held the position for twenty-seven years until her death in {{Ne|732}}. She was [[Cemaile Sorenthaine]]'s successor and [[Feragaine Saralman]]'s predecessor.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

She was in large part a puppet of the [[Hall of the Tower|Hall]], chosen because the [[Sitters]] thought she would be easily controlled by them. In fact, in large part it happened.

She was the last of the only three Yellow Amyrlin Seats of the [[New Era]].
